title: Beggars and the Poor
summary: Beggars often sat near gates, roads, or public places where they could ask for mercy from passersby.
background: Blindness, disability, poverty, and exclusion often pushed people into public dependence. Healing stories often unfold in these visible places of need.
teachingHelp: When a beggar appears, help listeners see both physical need and the mercy of God drawing near.
